ELA

Spelling: ie/ei Words, Silent Letters and Common Homophones

🎯 Objectives
Taught directly: E-SPE-55
Reinforces: E-SPE-53, E-SPE-54, E-SPE-56

Tricky spellings: 'i before e' and the there / their / they're words

Some spellings just have to be learned because they don't sound the way they look. Here are two that come up all the time.

Remember thisWrite i before e, except after c. So we write 'believe', but 'receive'.

Worked example

Choosing ie or ei.

  1. 'believe' has no c before the gap, so i before e: bel-ie-ve.
  2. 'receive' has a c before the gap, so e before i: rec-ei-ve.
Fill in the blank

Fill the gap in 'ach__ve' with ie or ei.____
